_note: Industry, street, ownership, moat, critiques, gaps and conflicts for the Chambal initiation. Sources dated on or before 30-Sep-2026 only.

urea.note: Urea sales grew ~3.8% a year over FY21-26; imports nearly doubled in FY26 as domestic output fell and demand rose; management puts consumption at ~40.4-40.5 mt vs production ~30.5-30.6 mt (Q1FY27 call).

cpc.market: ~₹40,000 cr (CPC, speciality nutrients, biologicals), growing 8-9% a year to ~₹54,000 cr by FY30; generics ~70%

tan.demand: ~1.2 mt of ammonium nitrate demand in India, growing 6-7% a year with mining and infrastructure; imports (largely Russian) restricted in 2026; new capacity from Chambal, Deepak (Gopalpur) and later Coal India/BHEL; Reliance reportedly evaluating

subsidyBudget.note: Fertiliser subsidy ₹1.71 lakh cr budgeted for FY27 vs ₹1.86 lakh cr revised for FY26; Elara (Apr-2026) estimated actual FY27 outgo of ₹2.19-2.83 lakh cr depending on prices, war duration and the rupee
subsidyBudget.src: SKP Q1FY27 note (3-Aug-2026); Elara sector preview (4-Apr-2026); q3fy26call

monsoon2026.monthly: June 65%, July 101%, August 84%, September 92% of LPA

brokers.thesis: Beat on traded margins; G-III EBIT/t cut from ₹7,494 (FY26) to ₹4,400 from FY28; strong FCF; fourth urea plant optionality
brokers.note: Jul note does not restate the basis; 14x Jun-28E is the basis in its 15-May-2026 note (TP ₹620)

brokers.thesis: Prudent NPK sourcing; G-III benefit ends Q4FY27 (EBITDA falls in FY28); TAN and a fourth plant for growth
TAN drives FY27; 'nearly one-third' cut in G-III EBITDA/t from Dec-2026; FY27 may be peak PAT, not crossed until FY30
brokers.note: 11x Q1FY29E EPS (₹50.5), i.e. the June-2028 quarter

brokers.thesis: Initiation: urea a regulated annuity, TAN accretion gradual (<5% of revenue), risk-reward balanced
Before Q1FY27: TAN and diversification; no G-III reset visible in its EPS

consensus.note: IIFL (31-Jul-2026) put its FY27/28/29 EPS 10.9% / 18.5% / 10.6% below consensus, implying consensus EPS of ~₹52.3 / ₹52.6 / ₹49.3. A Trendlyne snapshot dated 4-Sep-2026 (seen via search; the live page now shows later data) gave an average target of ₹549.67 from three analysts (Buy). No other dated consensus was found.

street.split: Latest call per broker by 30-Sep-2026: four Buys (IIFL ₹610, JRK ₹587 (May), SKP ₹566, Elara ₹544) and one Hold (Systematix ₹500); no Sell. Three value the stock on P/E (9.5-14x FY28/Jun-28 EPS) and two on EV/EBITDA (5.6-8x FY28E). Every target is above the ₹409 share price.

notes: Promoters rose from 60.40% (Mar-2025) to 61.34% (Jun-2026) through market purchases (e.g. Jyotsna Poddar 1.06% to 1.66% in FY26).
FIIs fell from 20.18% (Mar-2025) to 14.92%; DIIs 4.59% to 5.34%. No foreign institution held 1% or more in Jun-2026.
About 23% of promoter shares were pledged in Jun-2026 (22.3% Sep-2025, 23.7% Dec-2025, 23.5% Mar-2026).
ownership.src: BSE shareholding pattern via Screener.in (Jun-2026 quarter; named holders from Screener's investor tables); pledge from Trendlyne and the Elara/IIFL notes (Jul-2026)

moat.evidence: G-I and G-II run 4-6% below the government's energy norms and G-III 2-3% below (Q3FY26 call); Chambal keeps the saving. Gas is a pass-through, so efficiency is the main controllable lever.
3.4 mt at Gadepan (~10% of Indian output): shared utilities, ammonia surplus that now feeds the TAN plant, land, water, rail siding and gas approval for a fourth plant.

moat.dimension: Distribution in north and central India
moat.evidence: 4,918 dealers and 93,000+ retailers in 14 states; urea brings farmers in, which sells traded P&K (12.3 lakh t in FY26) and CPC (₹1,203 cr).
Urea MRP and returns are set by policy (NIP-2012, NUP-2015, NIPU-2026's 12-16% ROE band); DAP is a fixed-margin product; NPK prices capped by affordability.
Asset-light trading of imported fertilisers (4% EBITDA margin in FY26) and sourced agrochemicals (~3% market share); no manufacturing or patents yet (TERI pipeline from FY29).
Long-term debt repaid (FY25); short-term borrowings only fund subsidy receivables; can fund a ₹9,500-10,000 cr plant and ride out subsidy delays.

critiques.argument: Gadepan-III's NIP-2012 pricing ends in December 2026; brokers cut its EBITDA per tonne by about a third (Elara) or EBIT/t from ₹7,494 to ₹4,400 (IIFL), so FY27 may be the profit peak until FY30.
The TAN market may turn long within one to two years (Deepak's Gopalpur plant, Coal India/BHEL, a possible Reliance entry, Russian imports), capping prices that are elevated today.
critiques.who: Analyst questions on Q1FY27 call; management concedes 'short or slightly long... for not more than a year'

critiques.argument: A fourth urea plant would cost ₹9,500-10,000 cr at returns management itself calls 'dilutive' versus NIP-2012; it would absorb the cash pile and rule out buybacks.
Traded-fertiliser profit is lumpy: a ₹419 cr loss in FY23, 4% margin in FY26, 13.7% in Q1FY27 only because stock was bought before the war.
critiques.who: GAM Research from segment data; management ('it will decline')

critiques.argument: Subsidy receivables ballooned from ₹368 cr (Mar-25) to ₹2,462 cr (Jun-26), turning net cash into net debt of ~₹200 cr; the government's fiscal room is tighter in a high-price year.
critiques.who: Aequitas on the Q4FY26 call; company data

critiques.argument: About 23% of promoter shares are pledged.

gaps: Plant-wise (G-I/G-II vs G-III) EBITDA and depreciation are not disclosed; the Gadepan-III reset is sized from broker estimates (Elara, IIFL).
The post-December-2026 pricing formula for Gadepan-III was undecided on 30-Sep-2026.
TAN margins are not disclosed; FY27 booked volume and price are our estimates.
Rabi 2026-27 NBS rates were not announced by 30-Sep-2026; we leave them out.
No pooled gas price beyond the Q1FY27 provisional US$17.25/mmBtu; our realisation path is an assumption.
Surplus ammonia sales volumes are disclosed only occasionally (~23,000 t in Q1FY26).
IMACID's FY27-29 profit and dividends are our estimates; only its FY25-26 results and the capacity plan are public.
Exact commissioning years of Gadepan-I and Gadepan-II are not in the sources we reviewed.
Q1FY25 urea production and the Q4FY25 DAP volume (shown as nil) were not verified.
No dated consensus EPS by 30-Sep-2026 other than the figure implied by IIFL's 'vs consensus' line; the ₹549.67 Trendlyne average target (4-Sep-2026) was seen only through a search snapshot.
The fourth urea plant (₹9,500-10,000 cr) and the overseas phosphate JV had no Board decision by 30-Sep-2026 and are not modelled.
conflicts: Q1FY27 urea segment EBIT: ₹434.5 cr in the company presentation vs ₹431.8 cr in IIFL's table; we use the presentation.
Promoter pledge: Elara, IIFL and Trendlyne show ~23% of promoter shares pledged; Systematix's initiation shows none. We use ~23%.
Gadepan-III policy end: management says the new regime applies 'from December 1st'; brokers write 'December 2026' or 'Q4FY27'. We apply the cut from December 2026.
IMACID expansion timing: 'December 2026' (Q3/Q4FY26 calls) vs 'April to June 2027' (Q1FY27 call); we use the later date.
